method: FilterCatalog entries of the release in FilterCatalog order. 'smarts' is what RDKit.js parses: the source SMARTS ('verbatim', when parsing it without mergeHs rebuilds the native entry byte for byte) or native RDKit's SMARTS of the mergeHs pattern ('merged', a writer fixed point with every atom and bond query described alike). 'written' is MolToSmarts of that parse, which RDKit.js's get_smarts must reproduce. An entry matches when the molecule has at least min_count unique matches (SmartsMatcher); the alerts are (filter_set, description) in entry order, the first of each pair kept, as rules.alerts keeps them.
